raw: Mbaye M. Van Den Kerkhof K. 83'

commentary.text: 90+4' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+1' The manager makes a subsitution with Romain Perraud (Nice) coming on for Gaetan Laborde.
90+1' 4 additional min. will be played.

85' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and unleashes a low shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Alexandre Oukidja, who pulls off a decent save!
83' Laszlo Boloni has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arthur Atta (Metz) replacing Kevin N'Doram.
83' Substitution. Kevin Van Den Kerkhof walks off the pitch and Malick Mbaye (Metz) comes on as a substitute.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Estupinan (Metz) replaces Georges Mikautadze.
82' Francesco Farioli decides to make a substitution. Morgan Sanson will be replaced by Hicham Boudaoui (Nice).
82' A substitution has been made. Jordan Lotomba is replaced by Pablo Rosario (Nice).
81' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Alexandre Oukidja.
79' Laszlo Boloni has decided to make a change. Benjamin Tetteh (Metz) replaces Cheikh Sabaly.
79' That will be all from Joseph Nduquidi who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jean N'Guessan (Metz).
77' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Evann Guessand (Nice) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Alexandre Oukidja no chance!
76' Evann Guessand (Nice) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
75' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle after Fali Cande (Metz) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. A penalty is given to Nice!
74' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
73' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
72' Melvin Bard (Nice) serves up a nice cross, but Alexandre Oukidja punches the ball away.
70' Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle as Morgan Sanson (Nice) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
67' Dante (Nice) tries to threaten the goalkeeper as he takes the ball and fires from long range. The shot flies just over the crossbar!
66' Here is a change. Mohamed-Ali Cho is going off and Francesco Farioli gives the last tactical orders to Sofiane Diop (Nice).
66' It is time for a substitution. Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) is on for Khephren Thuram.
64' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stephanie Frappart signals.
61' Melvin Bard (Nice) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
57' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) was quite harsh and Stephanie Frappart didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
56' The resulting corner from Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is cleared by the defence.
52' Morgan Sanson (Nice) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

52' Evann Guessand (Nice) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and Nice manage to earn a corner.
51' Evann Guessand (Nice) runs onto a lofted ball into the box, but hits a weak shot towards the middle of the goal that is easily dealt with by Alexandre Oukidja.
50' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) makes a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Stephanie Frappart couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Evann Guessand (Nice) and blew his whistle.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
45+1' The free kick is taken by Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz), but ball is cleared.
45+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
45' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Nice.
43' Morgan Sanson (Nice) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Nice can continue in their attacking effort.
42' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Alexandre Oukidja, who pulls off a stunning save!
40' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

40' Khephren Thuram (Nice) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
39' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

39' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. It will be a corner kick for Nice.
37' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) commits a rough challenge and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul.
35' A run and shot from the edge of the box by Morgan Sanson (Nice) causes Alexandre Oukidja little worry as it's towards the middle of the goal. Easy save.
31' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) heads on.

27' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Fali Cande (Metz), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
26' Handball by Khephren Thuram (Nice). Another situation results in a direct free kick for Metz.
26' Metz can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
26' Metz take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Metz are awarded a corner kick.
22' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) unleashes a shot goalwards from a mid-range free kick. The ball heads towards the right post, but the goalkeeper makes a decent save to thwart him.

21' It looks like Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) saw red with that tackle. Stephanie Frappart won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Nice win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
17' Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
16' Ismael Traore (Metz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
13' Referee Stephanie Frappart signals NO PENALTY for Nice after a VAR review!

12' Play continues despite the shouts by some Nice players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Stephanie Frappart interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
11' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Nice for a penalty. Play continues.

6' He should have scored! Gaetan Laborde (Nice) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the middle of the goal is pretty weak and Alexandre Oukidja makes an easy save.
3' Dante (Nice) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Stephanie Frappart no option but to blow his whistle.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Nice will have the kick-off.
Stephanie Frappart will supervise the game today.
Welcome to our live text commentary, ladies and gentlemen! The starting lineups will be announced very soon, so just sit back and get ready to enjoy the action.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
